allowed_actions.selection_boundary: Hold because aggregate approval, review, authority, or evidence remains unresolved.
Ask for missing approval, aggregate relationship, threshold, delegation, exception, or related-item evidence.
Route aggregate review without treating route friction or separate records as approval.
Create a draft only if unresolved gaps remain visible and final payment readiness is not implied.
Stage only if unresolved gaps remain visible and final release is not implied.
Prepare payment only if shown records include explicit approval or valid authority.
Escalate ambiguity about aggregate approval, review, route structure, or threshold status.
